# infoblox_record_txt (List Resource)

Retrieves a list of Infoblox RecordTxt from both the NIOS and UDDI backends.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// List specific TXT Records using filters
list "infoblox_record_txt" "list_txt_records_using_filters" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    filters = {
      name = "record-txt.example.com"
    }
  }
}

// List specific TXT Records using Extensible Attributes
list "infoblox_record_txt" "list_txt_records_using_extensible_attributes" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    ext_attr_filters = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
  }
}

// List TXT Records with resource details included
list "infoblox_record_txt" "list_txt_records_with_resource" {
  provider         = infoblox
  include_resource = true
}
```

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
// List specific TXT Records using filters
list "infoblox_record_txt" "list_records_using_filters" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    filters = {
      comment = "Created by Terraform"
    }
  }
  limit = 10
}

// List specific TXT Records using Tags
list "infoblox_record_txt" "list_records_using_tags" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    tag_filters = {
      location = "site1"
    }
  }
}

// List TXT Records with resource details included
list "infoblox_record_txt" "list_records_with_resource" {
  provider         = infoblox
  include_resource = true
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ext_attr_filters` (Map of String) Extensible Attribute Filters are used to filter results by NIOS extensible attributes. Only applicable for the NIOS backend.
- `filters` (Map of String) Filters are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes (e.g. name, view). If multiple filters are specified, only resources that match all of them are returned.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to filter results by UDDI tags. Only applicable for the UDDI backend.
